readings: Which are the top 10 members by share of total event attendance? Join attendance to member on member id, count attendance records per member id and position, and divide each count by the total number of ALL rows in the attendance table, including any rows whose member id has no matching member. Show member id, position, attendance count and share, ordered from highest share to lowest, limited to 10.

Which are the top 10 members by share of total event attendance? Join attendance to member on member id (inner join), count attendance records per member id and position, and divide each count by the total number of attendance records that match an existing member, ignoring rows with no matching member. Show member id, position, attendance count and share, ordered from highest share to lowest, limited to 10.
queries:
SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS share
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a2 INNER JOIN member m2 ON a2.link_to_member = m2.member_id) AS share
FROM attendance a
INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
